supersession_reason: The preregistered mixshift4p50 gray-weight-1 arm completed after V1 and showed a small conditional positive gray-loss effect; V2 corrects the gray conclusion without changing the final model or score.

scope.coarse_input: frozen SAM-Med3D fixed click-3 raw logits
scope.status: validation-selected development result; not independent test and not automatic localization

main_finding.protocol: 3 robustshift4 seeds x fixed 8-reflection TTA with equal float32 logit mean, then locked threshold -1.0 and removal of 26-connected components below 500 voxels

ablation_chain.name: three-seed x eight-reflection TTA with locked postprocess

uncertainty.interpretation: The finite-validation point estimate crosses 0.70, but the narrow margin does not establish population Dice above 0.70. The paired gain over epoch58 is positive.

robust_training.training_only_corruption: independent random coarse-logit translation up to 4 voxels per axis with zero-filled borders; image and label do not receive this extra translation

gray_loss_conclusion.implementation: MSE between GT-region T1ce mean and sigmoid-logit-weighted predicted-region T1ce mean
gray_loss_conclusion.conclusion: Gray loss has a small conditional regularization benefit in the weaker 50-percent-shift regime, but effects are inconsistent and the gray arm remains 0.010455 below the best no-gray robustshift4 model. The final >0.70 protocol contains no gray loss.

selection_caveat.postprocess: threshold -1.0 and removal of components below 500 voxels were selected on the same 108 validation cases before the two additional seeds
selection_caveat.implication: 0.700419 is a validation-selected development score, not an unbiased generalization estimate
selection_caveat.next_required_evidence: freeze the complete protocol and evaluate once on a new external or confirmation set; do not tune on the revealed 270-case test
